content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Foreigners Tribunal Goalpara Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Data Entry Operator post is scheduled for 08 September 2026. Candidates should report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Data Entry Operator position?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed HS from a recognized Board/Council and possess a minimum 6-month Computer Diploma with DTP knowledge.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Data Entry Operator role?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 18 years and 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 10,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Documents Verification, a Personal Interview, and a Computer Skill Test.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Foreigners Tribunal Goalpara office. The exact venue details are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the Data Entry Operator position is a contractual job.

faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Data Entry Operator post.
